# Forage Germany

> A free guide to wild food in Germany: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 29 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brennnessel. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Bärlauch. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Löwenzahn. In season March to October.
- [Ground elder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/groundelder/): Aegopodium podagraria; Giersch. In season March to June.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Vogelmiere. In season March to November.
- [Common sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/sorrel/): Rumex acetosa; Sauerampfer. In season April to August.
- [Wood sorrel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/woodsorrel/): Oxalis acetosella; Waldsauerklee. In season April to September.
- [Garlic mustard](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/garlicmustard/): Alliaria petiolata; Knoblauchsrauke. In season March to June.
- [Fat hen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/fathen/): Chenopodium album; Weißer Gänsefuß. In season May to September.
- [Ribwort plantain](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/plantain/): Plantago lanceolata; Spitzwegerich. In season April to September.

- [Sweet violet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/sweetviolet/): Viola odorata; Duftveilchen. In season February to April.
- [Wood avens root](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/plants/woodavens/): Geum urbanum; Echte Nelkenwurz. In season March to October.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower syrup (Holunderblütensirup)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/elderflower-syrup/): Flowers steeped with lemon, strained and boiled with sugar. Mixed with sparkling water as Hugo or Holunderschorle.
- [Woodruff punch (Maibowle)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/woodruff-punch/): Wilted woodruff briefly steeped in white wine and topped with sparkling wine.
- [Sea buckthorn juice (Sanddornsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/sea-buckthorn-juice/): Sour Baltic coast berries juiced and sweetened.
- [Sloe liqueur (Schlehenlikör)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/sloe-liqueur/): Frosted sloes steeped in grain spirit with rock sugar.
- [Rose hip tea (Hagebuttentee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Dried rose hips simmered into a ruby tea.
- [Elderflower fritters (Hollerküchle)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/elderflower-fritters/): Flower heads in pancake batter, fried and sugared. A Bavarian and Swabian favourite.
- [Wild garlic soup (Bärlauchsuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/wild-garlic-soup/): Creamy potato soup blended with wild garlic.
- [Roasted chestnuts (Maronen)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/roasted-chestnuts/): Scored and roasted chestnuts from Christmas markets.
- [Wild garlic pesto (Bärlauchpesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Wild garlic, hard cheese, nuts and oil.
- [Lingonberry compote (Preiselbeeren)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/lingonberry-compote/): Lingonberries cooked with sugar to serve with game and Wiener Schnitzel.
- [Dandelion syrup (Löwenzahnhonig)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/dandelion-syrup/): Flower heads simmered with lemon and sugar into a vegan 'honey'.
- [Ground elder pesto (Gierschpesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/ground-elder-pesto/): Young ground elder leaves blended with nuts and oil.
- [Nettle spinach (Brennnesselspinat)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/nettle-spinach/): Blanched nettles creamed with onion and nutmeg, with fried eggs and potatoes.
- [Wild garlic Maultaschen](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/wild-garlic-maultaschen/): Swabian pasta pockets filled with wild garlic and meat or cheese.
- [Hop shoots in butter (Hopfenspargel)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/hop-shoots-in-butter/): Blanched hop shoots in butter, a Hallertau spring delicacy.
- [Bilberry pancakes (Heidelbeerpfannkuchen)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/bilberry-pancakes/): Thick pancakes studded with bilberries, a Black Forest classic.
- [Elderberry soup (Fliederbeersuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/elderberry-soup/): Northern German hot elderberry soup with apple and semolina dumplings.
- [Red berry pudding (Rote Grütze)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/red-berry-pudding/): Summer berries thickened with starch, with vanilla sauce.
- [Gooseberry meringue cake (Stachelbeerbaiser)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/gooseberry-meringue-cake/): Gooseberries under a crisp meringue on shortcrust.
- [Birch sap (Birkensaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/birch-sap/): Fresh spring sap, chilled.
- [Lamb's lettuce with bacon (Feldsalat)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/lamb-s-lettuce-with-bacon/): Feldsalat with warm bacon, croutons and potato dressing.
- [Chanterelles with scrambled egg (Pfifferlinge mit Rührei)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/chanterelles-with-scrambled-egg/): Pfifferlinge fried with onion and folded into eggs.
- [Rowan jelly (Vogelbeergelee)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan with apple, set into jelly for game.
- [Pickled wild cherries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/pickled-wild-cherries/): Wild cherries in spiced syrup.
- [Porcini in cream with dumplings (Steinpilze mit Knödel)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/porcini-in-cream-with-dumplings/): Creamy porcini sauce with bread dumplings, a Bavarian classic.
- [Green sauce (Grüne Soße) with wild herbs](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/green-sauce-with-wild-herbs/): Frankfurt-style herb sauce of seven herbs with eggs and potatoes.
- [Chicken of the woods schnitzel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/chicken-of-the-woods-schnitzel/): Breaded slices of Schwefelporling, fried.
- [Elderflower cake (Holunderblütenkuchen)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/elderflower-cake/): Sponge with elderflower syrup glaze.
- [Elderberry and plum compote](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/de/dishes/elderberry-and-plum-compote/): Fliederbeeren and plums stewed with cinnamon.
